<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeProcess.cs" Link="Shared/NodeProcess.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeProcessResult.cs" Link="Shared/NodeProcessResult.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeCaptureProtocol.cs" Link="Shared/NodeCaptureProtocol.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeDiagnostics.cs" Link="Shared/NodeDiagnostics.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeNames.cs" Link="Shared/NodeNames.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeErlangString.cs" Link="Shared/NodeErlangString.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeStringSyntax.cs" Link="Shared/NodeStringSyntax.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeFields.cs" Link="Shared/NodeFields.cs" />
    <Compile Include="../Erlang.NodeIdentityContrasts/NodeModuleSource.cs" Link="Shared/NodeModuleSource.cs" />
    <None Update="mixed_map_identity_probe.erl" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />
    <None Update="source-plan.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>

-module(mixed_map_identity_probe).
-export([run/1]).

run(Output) ->
    put(output, Output),
    save("stage", <<"started">>),
    try
        observe(),
        save("stage", <<"complete">>),
        halt(0)
    catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
        term("exception", {Class, Reason, Stack}),
        save("stage", <<"exception">>),
        halt(1)
    end.

observe() ->
    false = erlang:is_alive(),
    nonode@nohost = node(),
    Owner = self(),
    LocalReference = make_ref(),
    ReferenceBytes = <<131, 90, 3:16, 119, 6, "a@host", 7:32,
                       1:32, 2:32, 3:32>>,
    ExternalReference = binary_to_term(ReferenceBytes),
    PidBytes = external_pid_bytes(Owner),
    ExternalPid = binary_to_term(PidBytes),
    ReferenceMap = #{LocalReference => local_reference,
                     ExternalReference => external_reference},
    PidMap = #{Owner => local_pid, ExternalPid => external_pid},
    Combined = maps:merge(ReferenceMap, PidMap),
    Pairs = [{reference, LocalReference, ExternalReference, ReferenceMap,
              #{ReferenceMap => retained_reference_map}},
             {pid, Owner, ExternalPid, PidMap,
              #{PidMap => retained_pid_map}}],
    CombinedOuter = #{Combined => retained_combined_map},
    Name = '0',
    Options = #{name_domain => shortnames, dist_listen => false},
    term("inputs", #{name => Name, options => Options,
                     external_reference_bytes => ReferenceBytes,
                     external_pid_bytes => PidBytes,
                     external_creation => 7}),
    try
        snapshot("before", Pairs, Combined, CombinedOuter),
        Started = net_kernel:start(Name, Options),
        term("started-operation", Started),
        require_started(Started),
        snapshot("started", Pairs, Combined, CombinedOuter),
        Stopped = net_kernel:stop(),
        term("stopped-operation", Stopped),
        require_stopped(Stopped),
        snapshot("stopped", Pairs, Combined, CombinedOuter)
    after
        term("cleanup-kernel", outcome(fun net_kernel:stop/0))
    end.

external_pid_bytes(Pid) ->
    <<131, 88, Body/binary>> = term_to_binary(Pid),
    <<131, AtomBytes/binary>> = term_to_binary(node(Pid)),
    AtomSize = byte_size(AtomBytes),
    <<_:AtomSize/binary, Number:32, Serial:32, _Creation:32>> = Body,
    <<131, 88, 119, 6, "a@host", Number:32, Serial:32, 7:32>>.

require_started({ok, Kernel}) when is_pid(Kernel) -> ok;
require_started(Other) -> error({probe_start_failed, Other}).

require_stopped(ok) -> ok;
require_stopped(Other) -> error({probe_stop_failed, Other}).

snapshot(Phase, Pairs, RetainedCombined, CombinedOuter) ->
    Rows = [pair_snapshot(Phase, Pair) || Pair <- Pairs],
    RebuiltCombined = maps:from_list(lists:append(
        [[{Local, local_value(Name)}, {External, external_value(Name)}]
         || {Name, Local, External, _Map, _Outer} <- Pairs])),
    term(Phase ++ "-combined-retained", RetainedCombined),
    term(Phase ++ "-combined-rebuilt", RebuiltCombined),
    term(Phase ++ "-facts",
         #{node => node(), alive => erlang:is_alive(),
           creation => erlang:system_info(creation), pairs => Rows,
           combined => map_facts(RetainedCombined, RebuiltCombined,
                                 CombinedOuter)}).

pair_snapshot(Phase, {Name, Local, External, Retained, Outer}) ->
    Rebuilt = #{Local => local_value(Name), External => external_value(Name)},
    Prefix = Phase ++ "-" ++ atom_to_list(Name),
    term(Prefix ++ "-identifiers", {Local, External}),
    term(Prefix ++ "-retained-map", Retained),
    term(Prefix ++ "-rebuilt-map", Rebuilt),
    #{name => Name, local_node => node(Local), external_node => node(External),
      identifier_order => {Local < External, External < Local,
                            Local =:= External},
      local_lookup => outcome(fun() -> maps:find(Local, Retained) end),
      external_lookup => outcome(fun() -> maps:find(External, Retained) end),
      map => map_facts(Retained, Rebuilt, Outer)}.

map_facts(Retained, Rebuilt, Outer) ->
    #{exact_equal => Retained =:= Rebuilt,
      numeric_equal => Retained == Rebuilt,
      order => {Retained < Rebuilt, Rebuilt < Retained},
      retained_list => maps:to_list(Retained),
      rebuilt_list => maps:to_list(Rebuilt),
      retained_sorted_list => lists:sort(maps:to_list(Retained)),
      rebuilt_sorted_list => lists:sort(maps:to_list(Rebuilt)),
      hashes => {erlang:phash2(Retained), erlang:phash2(Rebuilt)},
      retained_map_key_lookup => outcome(fun() -> maps:find(Retained, Outer) end),
      rebuilt_map_key_lookup => outcome(fun() -> maps:find(Rebuilt, Outer) end),
      retained_binary => term_to_binary(Retained),
      rebuilt_binary => term_to_binary(Rebuilt)}.

local_value(reference) -> local_reference;
local_value(pid) -> local_pid.

external_value(reference) -> external_reference;
external_value(pid) -> external_pid.

outcome(Fun) ->
    try {result, Fun()}
    catch Class:Reason:Stack -> {exception, Class, Reason, Stack}
    end.

term(Name, Value) -> save(Name ++ ".etf", term_to_binary(Value)).

save(Name, Bytes) ->
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(get(output), Name), Bytes).

# Mixed local/external map observations

This standalone additive collector runs one genuine mixed_map_identity_probe in a fresh source-built pinned OTP VM. It reuses unchanged published NodeIdentity process, string and runtime-attestation helpers by compile links; it does not invoke the four prior probes.

Run with the source-built OTP root, a fresh output path, and source-build evidence JSON. It captures 32 declared raw files for before/start/stop reference and PID mixed maps: retained/rebuilt equality, ordering, map-key lookup, phash2 and current ETF bytes. Expected semantic outcomes are unset. Ports are deferred. Runtime, compile, disassembly and probe raw bytes/exit/deadlines accompany pin/JIT/build/source bindings. Completion means capture completeness only.

The joint manual packet workflow builds OTP once and launches packet and mixed-map observations in separate fresh VMs. No runtime identity implementation, network handshake or whole-module compatibility is claimed.

name: Pinned OTP distribution packet observations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - name: Build standalone distribution packet observation tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.DistributionPacketContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.MixedMapIdentityContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/mixed-map-tool-build.log
      - name: Build and attest the pinned development compiler
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_BEGIN $GITHUB_SHA"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch OTP-29.1.1 https://github.com/erlang/otp.git artifacts/beam-otp-source
            source_commit="$(git -C artifacts/beam-otp-source rev-parse HEAD)"
            test "$source_commit" = ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_VERIFIED $source_commit"
            cd artifacts/beam-otp-source
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_CONFIGURE --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et'
            ./configure --prefix="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle" --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_MAKE -j2'
            make -j2
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL'
            make install
            test "$(cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang/releases/29/OTP_VERSION")" = 29.1.1
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL_VERIFIED 29.1.1'
          } 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          log = root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-build.log'
          evidence = {
              'SourceCommit': 'ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5',
              'SourceTag': 'OTP-29.1.1',
              'SourceBuildCompleted': True,
              'InstalledOtpRoot': str(root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang'),
              'SourceBuildLog': str(log),
              'SourceBuildLogSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
              'HarnessCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
              'RunId': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'RunAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'Job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'],
              'RunnerOs': os.environ['RUNNER_OS'],
              'ConfigureOptions': ['--without-javac','--without-wx','--without-odbc','--without-debugger','--without-observer','--without-et'],
              'BuildArguments': ['make','-j2'],
              'InstallArguments': ['make','install']
          }
          (root / 'artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Capture actual process-controller SEND and REG_SEND in a fresh VM
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.DistributionPacketContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/distribution-packet artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - name: Capture one mixed map transition in a separate fresh VM
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.MixedMapIdentityContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/mixed-map-identity artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-distribution-packet
          path: |
            artifacts/distribution-packet
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-mixed-map-identity
          path: |
            artifacts/mixed-map-identity
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/mixed-map-tool-build.log
